title: Relational Context Predicate Induction

frozen_heldout.execution_mode: learned relational program-graph context predicates + compiled Python patches + executable tests

bounded_causal_claim: On the frozen generated Python family, a relational context predicate induced from changed and unchanged AST sites transfers across nested/deep alias reshaping where the fixed R2.48 context baseline fails 0/6, while R2.49 succeeds 6/6 with sparse counterexample feedback and exhaustive executable certification.
non_claims: This is not a probability that Nolane-AI is AGI.
This does not establish W5 or general coding-AGI convergence.
This does not establish interprocedural, multi-file, repository-scale, noisy-test, or open-ended edit-language transfer.
